observations: 2014 BMC Plant Biology study profiling growing and mature Arabidopsis root hairs by microarray and comparing the data with pollen-tube and other single-cell transcriptomes.

entities.name: Shared apical growth signature
observations: PCA of Arabidopsis root-hair and pollen-tube transcriptome datasets suggested a common apical-growth expression pattern; overlap included small GTPases, vesicle-mediated transport, and specific metabolic responses. Authors described this as suggestive and a foundation for further testing, not definitive proof of a universal program.
Co-regulated genes contained conserved cis-regulatory motifs, including motifs associated with anaerobic responses.
